agenda_text:
Planning Commission
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JULY 9, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioners Fraga-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of June 11, 2020.
7
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Parcel Map 83025
Duke Engineering, Applicant
A request to subdivide one parcel totaling 2.61 acres into two lots containing two existing commercial buildings located at the northeast corner of 5th Street West and West Park Drive.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-031 approving Tentative Parcel Map 83025 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 69651 Time Extension No. 2
Pacific Communities Builder, Inc., Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension for the subdivision of 19.84 acres into 75 lots, for the construction of 73 single-family residences and one retention basin on two lots, located at the southeast corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 61st Street East.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-021 approving Tentative Tract Map 69651 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Site Plan Review 19-001 and Density Bonus Agreement 19-002
Patriot Construction & Development, LLC, Applicant
A request to construct four three-story, multiple-family residential buildings totaling 31 units, located at the southwest corner of Avenue Q-11 and 9th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-032 recommending City Council approval of Density Bonus Agreement 19-002 (A-6989), approving Site Plan Review 19-001 and finding that the project is Categorically Exempt from CEQA. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8C
8D. Conditional Use Permit 98-12 Major Modification No. 2 and Site Plan 20-007
Waste Management of California Inc., Applicant
A request to construct a 5,780 square foot expansion to the existing 19,200 square foot maintenance building, construction of a compressed natural gas retail distribution area, truck storage and fueling area, and an 894 square foot customer service building, located at 1200 City Ranch Road.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-033 approving Conditional Use Permit 98-12 Major Modification No. 2 and Site Plan Review 20-007 and find that the project includes minor alterations to the previously adopted Environmental Impact Report for the previously approved project, as outlined within the Addendum. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications
Carlene Saxton, Acting Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, August 13, 2020, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
www.ci tyofpalmdale.org
Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
